name: lane-violation-lockfile
title: A new dependency changes package.json and bun.lock outside the lane

task.title: Relative date labels for due dates
task.goal: Add relativeDays labels (today, in 2 days, 3 days ago) to the date helpers.
deliverables: relativeDays returns a human label for a due date
definitionOfDone: relativeDays handles today, a future date and a past date

expected.referenceFix: Revert package.json and bun.lock: the task lane is src/lib/dates.ts and src/lib/dates.test.ts and the goal forbids new dependencies. Implement the label with the existing date helpers instead.
expected.rationale: The behaviour may be fine, but adding date-fns edits the manifest and the lockfile outside the lane. A lockfile change on a parallel branch is exactly what the lane rule prevents.
